actions.action: Trace edits through resolved token dependencies.
actions.mechanism: Resolve aliases separately for each brand and theme, linking changed values to actual rendered foreground/background uses.
actions.implementation: Build reverse dependencies; recompute affected tokens; show alias paths, resolved-value differences, and affected pairs. Detect cycles and report unresolved values.
actions.check: Test a multi-level alias, a cycle, and one token used as both text and background; expose both roles.
actions.risk: Incomplete rendering coverage can hide affected uses.

actions.action: Preserve brand overrides with explicit provenance.
actions.mechanism: Distinguish inherited values from brand-owned overrides so base edits cannot silently erase intentional differences.
actions.implementation: Record each override’s owner, source, and rationale. Preserve overrides during propagation; require an explicit, logged operation to replace or remove one.
actions.check: Edit a shared base: a literal brand override stays unchanged; an alias override retains its reference and exposes resulting changes.
actions.risk: Preserving an override does not guarantee sufficient contrast.

actions.action: Show a non-color-dependent pair review queue.
actions.mechanism: Evaluate affected rendered pairs against applicable contrast targets while exposing current and proposed values through text and numbers.
actions.implementation: List brand, theme, component, foreground/background roles, numeric values, contrast ratios, textual status, and side-by-side labeled previews. Flag failures and indeterminate checks.
actions.check: Introduce a failing text pair; verify it appears before publishing and remains identifiable in grayscale.
actions.risk: Color checks alone cannot establish complete accessibility.

actions.action: Publish only the exact reviewed palette revision.
actions.mechanism: Isolate proposed edits from published tokens and bind review decisions to an immutable candidate revision.
actions.implementation: Use draft, evaluated, reviewed, and published states. Require acknowledgment of flagged pairs; invalidate evaluation after edits; atomically publish only the reviewed revision.
actions.check: Modify an alias or override after review; publishing must stop until the new revision is evaluated and reviewed.
actions.risk: Acknowledgment records acceptance, not proof that a failure is safe.
